notes.title: Episode 0.99.04 - Hallucinations
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/b321b1b94d4ab1da6be1b2098fc0bffdb708dfc2.png"][/img][/p][p]Helloooooo there thrill seekers and death-defiers! JRDarkX here with MIND-BENDING updates that's going to make you question EVERYTHING you see![/p][p][/p][h3]Hallucinations: Where reality comes to die![/h3][p]That's right, contestants! Your already fragile grip on reality is about to get MUCH more slippery! Our revamped HALLUCINATION SYSTEM will have you second-guessing every shadow and face you see![/p][list][*][p]Is that your teammate or a flesh-eating monster? WHO KNOWS?![/p][/*][*][p]Are you seeing Contestants as Employees? Employees as Contestants?[/p][/*][*][p]Are those things even THERE at all?![/p][/*][/list][p]And here's a little Hot Tip from yours truly: Not sure if what you're seeing is real? There's always one way to check... WITH YOUR FISTS! That's right! A good old-fashioned PUNCH can reveal the truth![/p][p][/p][h3]SANITY: GOING, GOING, GONE![/h3][p]Your sanity now drains at DIFFERENT RATES depending on the day! Some days are just more... MADDENING than others![/p][p]Combat and maintain sanity with a variety of items that can help keep that noggin of yours in check, but we'll leave that for you to figure out.[/p][p]Oh, and trying to use items on your friends? Forget about it! Sharing is caring but you can't hold their hands.[/p][p][/p][h3]BONUS ROOMS/ROUNDS![/h3][p]Get tired of walking allllllll the way back to the start of the Glass Bridge or Bonus Rooms? Let's put those Shadow People to use! Hop into the lockers found in these rooms to take you back where you started.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other Production Notes:[/h3][p]Let's see what else we had to cover.[/p][list][*][p]Added EXTRA BATTERIES to Day 1! The newer contestants kept running into walls. HILARIOUS, but bad for ratings![/p][/*][*][p]The greenroom van button is now HOST-ONLY! Only they can start the party![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various SFX effects.[/p][/*][*][p]The end-day gas is now 100% LETHAL! No more CPR revivals! When you're dead, YOU'RE DEAD![/p][/*][*][p]Our exit van now comes equipped with FIRE EXTINGUISHERS! No more burning to death after surviving all that horror! (Where's the fun in THAT?)[/p][/*][*][p]Our mannequins are now MORE TERRIFYING THAN EVER with fixed jump scare sounds and animations when they claim their victims![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Remember contestants, in 7 Minutes in Hell, your greatest enemy isn't the monsters... IT'S YOUR OWN MIND! We'll be watching... ALWAYS watching... 
JRDarkX Out![/p][p][/p]

Order from the provided clipboards and get shopping! notes.title: Episode 0.99.01
notes.notes:
Hello Contestants! JRDarkX here, coming at ya with another 7 Minutes in Hell update as we get prepared for that 1.0 PREMIERE! Let's jump in shall we?!
[h1]Employee Updates[/h1]
[h2]Welcome New Hires[/h2]
[h3]Shadow Beast[/h3]
Welcoming to the Arena, this LARGE huggable creature that enjoys long walks in the darkness. Dislikes include: flashlights, sunlight, well... just light in general. 
[h3]Mannequins[/h3]
I could have sworn the Mannequin was just standing over there... hmmm. Anyways these fiberglass filled humanoid shells can be found inside the arena. Be WARNED, I would keep an eye at them at ALL TIMES. They tend to... move when you're not looking!

[h2]Employee Memos[/h2][list]
[*] Mini Spiders can no longer open doors, not sure how they were able to reach the handle before.
[*] Rats have been trained to run away less, bite more. You're welcome!
[*] Gelly Cube have been taught to maneuver around objects.
[*] Screamers are sensitive to bright flashes of lights.
[*] Buckethead would like to remind you to please pickup after yourselves, if there is time to clean, there is STILL time on the clock to chase contestants!
[*] All employees have been trained to ignore voices from the other side. Only focus on living contestants.[/list]
[h1]Gameplay Updates[/h1][list]
[*] Uniforms now come with one extra pocket! 
[*] Most items are now throwable. Toss with purpose, or just panic-hurl like the rest of us.
[*] Items can now be shared! Want to pass that medkit? Look into your friend in the eyes as you apply that bandage.
[*] Motion Detectors now only detect motion on the same floor as its location. Does not detect motion through ceilings or floors.
[*] Shredders are now easier to shred items.
[*] The CRAPTO machine in the greenroom now lets you buy stock in bulk.
[*] New Upgrade Tokens.[/list]
[h1]Bug Reports & Optimizations[/h1][list]
[*] Jiangshi are now stunned properly when paper is attached to them.
[*] Dropping Radioactive materials now allows you to move at normal pace. 
[*] Posters are now able to be unlocked by meeting criteria.
[*] Various minor bug fixes and optimizations.
[*] Uniforms will appear to have less holes in them.
[*] Spreadable materials spread better? Watch where you step or what you're throwing around.[/list]
[h1]Community Updates[/h1]
[h2]New Steam Developer Homepage[/h2]
Gaggle Studios now has an official Developer Homepage on Steam! Follow us to stay informed about the latest developments for 7 Minutes in Hell and other exciting Gaggle Studios projects.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GaggleStudios]Visit Gaggle Studios on Steam[/url]!

[h2]Expanding the Discord Community:[/h2]
Our Discord server has evolved! What began as the 7 Minutes in Hell community hub is now expanding into the official Gaggle Studios server. Join us to connect with players across all our titles, get news, updates, and be part of our growing community!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/gaggle]Join our Community Discord Server[/url]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/db82bc163528ba831c468543c9a79eeec9e22b0b.png[/img]

That's it for now. Remember if you’re hearing footsteps… they’re probably yours.
— JRDarkX

notes.title: Episode 0.99 - What a Challenge!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/61e425ee9a8db01905fed5480c9e01fb5eec3094.png[/img]
Hellooooo, you beautiful disasterpieces! It’s your favorite host, the one, the only, JRDarkX, here to drag you kicking, screaming, and chaotically laughing through the latest scorching-hot update for 7 Minutes in Hell!

[h1]ARENA UPDATES[/h1]
[h3]NEW CHALLENGE ROOMS – DOORS, DECISIONS & DOOM![/h3]
Are you paying attention, contestants? Because the signs are EVERYWHERE… if you know where to look. Make your way across our all-new Challenge Rooms, dodge deadly traps with style, and pick the correct door to win fabulous prizes! Pick wrong? Well... you might just end up face-to-face with a “mutual friend”.

[h3]ITEM UPDATES[/h3]
[list]
[*] 8Ball - Now equipped to answer your questions.
[*] Poop – It's... poop. Don't step in it. Or do. We dare you.
[*] Glow Sticks – Light your way through the gloom. Rave optional.
[*] Uranium Core – Do not put this in your pocket. You’ve been warned.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/234c4951e1d3dea0230dda9b20ff60e0987c186c.png[/img]

[h3]EMPLOYEE UPDATES[/h3]
New HR Memo just dropped: Trained Dogs scare off rats and screamers.

[h3]RED LIGHT, GREEN LIGHT[/h3]
This game is a little more forgiving, you can now pick up items even during a red light (without moving your head). 

[h1]GREENROOM UPDATE[/h1]
[h3]NEW ITEMS TO UNLOCK[/h3]
Use those order forms and wait the one day delivery to unlock some new items to unlock in your Greenroom, a space to relax, exercise, goof off, whatever you're into. 

Items around the Greenroom are more interactive - pick up your collectibles, roll the giant dice, smash the urn (ashes not included)! More Interactions, More Fun!

[h1]VISUAL UPDATE [/h1]
[h3]AESTHETICS MODE: NOW OPTIONAL![/h3]
We get it. Some of you love streaming at  1080p quality, some of you love streaming at 160p. So now, thanks to your ever-enthusiastic feedback, you can toggle “Aesthetics Mode” right off and adjust your graphics to your heart’s content! 

[h1]BUG FIXES & OPTIMIZATIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Various Bug Fixes and Optimizations
[/list]

That’s all for now, brave contestants!
Dive in, suit up, and remember: in 7 Minutes in Hell, your only prize is survival... and maybe a trampoline.

Until next time,
This is JRDarkX, signing off!

notes.title: Episode 0.98: Almost There
notes.notes:
Hello Contestants!
WHOA 0.98 where does the time go?! Looks like we're getting close to the real deal, the real show, Episode 1 Point 0! This update is a HUGE one before we go LIVE so strap in and get ready for the BIGGEST UPDATE YET!

[h1]Visual Changes[/h1]
[h2]New Aesthetic[/h2]
We're changing the look and feel, starting with the look! We've gone ahead and COMPLETELY REVAMPED the visual style of this gameshow. With new visual style comes new graphical settings to get things looking how you want them to look.

[h2]New Transitions[/h2]
While you catch your breath between the Arena and the Greenroom, feast your eyes on our brand-new stream layout! That's right! During those loading screens, you can now [i]READ 'LIVE' REACTIONS[/i] from our bloodthirsty viewers in the chat! See what the audience REALLY thinks about your performance! Are they cheering for your survival or BETTING ON YOUR DEMISE? The ratings are through the roof, and the comments are ABSOLUTELY SAVAGE! Stay tuned—the audience is waiting, and the show must go on!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/7f99f57583202f548e3b65f601a800d6289a238d.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[h2]Sign the Waiver[/h2]
Having trouble reading it? Don't worry you weren't going to read it anyway.
Decide on a Team Name and individually sign up to compete in [i]7 Minutes in Hell[/i]! Each contestant will need to sign their own form. If teammates perish along the way, you'll need to find a replacement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/005e84ab4519fcb2f37b619f827a06da6d502686.png[/img]

[h2]Ready Set... Starting Room[/h2]
Let's make things feel like a real gameshow! What better place to start than well... the starting room! Newly equipped with Sponsor loading platform and item dispense chute! Perform your stretches and get equipped to face the challenges that await you ahead. We even went through the trouble of making sure there was a 'live' studio audience, [i]get it?[/i] THEY'RE DYING TO MEET YOU!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/b163f72a8f9c61a01b4098f49ce2e84c5e3c27ca.png[/img]

[h2]Changing the Rules[/h2]
7 Minutes. Find Exit. Win. 
Ok so the rules didn't really change but while finding the exit should be a BREEZE, here's the TWIST—it's LOCKED UP TIGHT! That's right! You'll need to collect those CASH BOXES scattered throughout the Arena if you want ANY CHANCE of escape! NO MONEY, NO EXIT, NO EXCEPTIONS!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/1cf7bac2c2622ddbe2d6aa85273832040983c3a8.png[/img]

[h2]Workbench + Scanner = Learning[/h2]
Check out that state-of-the-art SUPER SCANNER! Place those collected treasures right in and watch them get ANALYZED to the MAX, and BOOM! All that juicy information zips straight to the monitor as well as your workbench in the greenroom! Who knows perhaps you'll learn something. Who says learning can't be educational?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/0dae0ac33d1e36af99224780bec228c8a5bacfd2.gif[/img]

[h2]Contestant Boards[/h2]
Have you ever found the exit and wondered how your teammates were making out? Check out how much value their worth on the contestant displays found in the exit rooms to see who is worth waiting for.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/7b8c9ab9f90d9c20500b7bf5f10f1a22b5a21027.png[/img]

[h2]Oh the Insanity![/h2]
HOLD ONTO YOUR MINDS, FOLKS! Next to that nifty little health meter, we now have a sanity check. What happens when you lose sanity you may ask, perhaps you'll see things that aren't there, maybe you'll start hearing things, perhaps you'll see things that aren't there, perhaps you'll think that you read the same sentence twice but not sure if you read that before (ha gotcha). Maintain your sanity, there may be items that can help with that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/f015042535cfc9afbcf771f9033feeb2255f75a9.png[/img]

[h2]Down and Not Out (Yet)[/h2]
Sometimes you get knocked down, but with help of teammates, [i]ideally with an insta-revive[/i], you can get back up again... ONCE! You could say you only get up to a second wind in these Arenas! MAKE IT COUNT!

[h2]7 Minutes in Hell: The Addiction[/h2]
When contestants extract 7MIH: The Addiction cards, they'll be added to ALL contestant's Collector Albums. No more needing to hide them from your teammates, sharing is caring.

[h2]Welcome New Hires![/h2]
We brought in some new hires to mix things up and keep things interesting. They look forward to meeting you. AND BY MEETING, WE MEAN HUNTING YOU DOWN!

notes.title: Intermission Patch 0.06.04
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome back, contestants![/h3]
We're back, baby, with another patch—[i]and this one is literally crawling with improvements.[/i]. We heard your cries, your desperate gasps, and—let’s be honest—your incoherent shrieks, so we’ve gone ahead and fine-tuned the chaos just for you. We’ve expanded Hospital and Outdoor areas for better navigation, reworked maze puzzles to be slightly less cruel (especially for solo players). Oh, and poison antidotes are now easier to find—so if you still die, that’s on you. We’ve also tweaked employee behavior, fixed sync issues, and optimized performance, meaning everything wants to kill you more efficiently. Now get back in there—the suffering won’t start itself. 💀🔥

[h1]Patch Highlights[/h1]
[h2]Level Design Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Expanded Level Generation & Navigation:[/b]
[list][*] Added [b]new rooms[/b] to the [b]Hospital[/b] and [b]Outdoor[/b] areas to improve pathing and layout variety.[/list][*] Fixed various [b]room and corridor issues[/b] to prevent awkward dead-ends.
[*] Modified [b]trap and battery station positioning[/b] to balance gameplay.
[*] Fixed [b]collision issues and inaccessible areas[/b] (no more getting stuck in a doorway questioning life choices).
[*] Added [b]maze puzzle elements[/b] for both [b]multiplayer and solo play[/b]—making the [b]maze bonus round easier for solo players[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]faulty stairs and disposal areas[/b]—so you won’t trip and die unless [i]we[/i] say so.
[/list]

[h2]Employee Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Modified employee behavior[/b] (Blobcube, Spider, Jiangshi, Screamer).
[*] Balanced employee interactions with weapons and items—no more unfair grabs.
[*] Fixed employee [b]stun and damage mechanics[/b]—yes, you can actually fight back now.
[*] [b]Removed Floor Shadow People[/b]—they’ve gone back to their own dimension. For now.
[/list]

[h2]Item Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Poison Antidote[/b] is now part of the [b]essentials list[/b] and spawns [b]more frequently[/b].
[*] [b]Spider eggs are now flammable[/b]—torch them with the [b]incinerator or fire[/b] for [i]global effects[/i].
[*] [b]Container doors no longer interact with players[/b] when moved—no more physics-based betrayal.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed numerous player synchronization issues[/b]—no more “I definitely wasn’t there” deaths.
[*] Resolved employee [b]behavior and interaction issues[/b]—they still want you dead, but now more [i]fairly[/i].
[*] Fixed [b]collision detection and player movement problems[/b]—so walls actually behave like walls.
[*] Addressed [b]item interaction bugs[/b]—objects should now do what they’re told.
[*] Fixed [b]UI and HUD-related issues[/b]—so you actually know how much trouble you’re in.
[*] Resolved [b]level geometry problems and glitches[/b]—no more accidental void-walking.
[/list]

[h2]Vehicle Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed [b]van timer issues for hosts[/b]—so it doesn’t just abandon you randomly.
[*] Fixed [b]player triggers on disconnect[/b]—your corpse shouldn’t keep playing without you.
[*] Resolved [b]timer counting issues in the start room[/b]—time moves forward again, as it should.
[/list]

[h2]Network Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed player positioning synchronization[/b]—less jittery teleporting nonsense.
[*] [b]Improved disconnection handling[/b]—less “I got booted and now I’m in limbo.”
[*] [b]Fixed synchronization for shared objects[/b]—no more duplicated horror items causing chaos.
[/list]

[h2]UI and Player Experience[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added microphone level display during gameplay[/b]—because we [i]know[/i] you’re screaming.
[*] [b]Added settings for microphone testing[/b]—because clarity is key when you’re [i]begging for your life[/i].
[*] [b]Added skip JR commentary[/b] for van transitions—don’t worry, I’ll just [i]cry silently[/i] over here.
[*] [b]Updated hover text defaults[/b]—so you can actually read what’s about to kill you.
[/list]

[h2]Loading and Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed duplicate loading issues[/b] that were causing performance problems.
[*] [b]Optimized level generation[/b]—because Hell should run smoothly.
[/list]

That’s all for now, contestants! As always, keep the feedback coming, keep screaming, and keep running—because [i]we[/i] won’t stop making it worse.

See you in the Hellscape!
💀🔥 – *JRDarkX*

notes.title: Episode 0.06: Introducing Bonus Levels!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/1dde6ead6e164eca2f9dacd12e23f2bf0be159fc.png[/img]

[h1]New Bonus Rounds Have Entered the Arena![/h1]

[b]Welcome back, contestants![/b] Today, we're cranking up the chaos with [b]Episode 0.06[/b], featuring [b]brand-new Bonus Rounds![/b] These aren't your usual scream-filled, panic-ridden arenas—oh no, these are [i]special[/i]. You know that big, ominous Wheel that's been [i]just sitting there[/i] in the Loading Bay of your Greenroom this whole time? Yeah, the one you've all been [i]side-eyeing[/i] like it owes you money? 

[b]Well, guess what?[/b]
[b]It's finally ready to Spin, Spin, SPIN![/b] 🎡💀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/452b5abcfc4a1ab3a450e75f0b18419bd16366a9.gif[/img]

You might be wondering, [b]"What's a Bonus Round?"[/b] Well, it's exactly what it sounds like—[b]a chance for even more loot, internet fame, and prime material for our kill cams.[/b] (You know we love the kill cams.) So grab your courage and maybe an extra pair of pants, because once that wheel spins, there's no backing out!

But enough stalling—let's get to the [i]real[/i] fun.

[h2]💀 Bonus Rounds Added! 💀[/h2]
There are [b]three[/b] different Bonus Rounds that could be your next nightmare—er, [i]challenge.[/i]

[h3]🚦 Red Light, Green Light[/h3]
Ah, a classic children's game... except now with [b]lasers and highly unstable animatronics[/b]! You'll be dropped into a room full of goodies—grab what you can—but [b]move during Red Light, and our laser-eyed statue will turn you into contestant confetti.[/b] Oh, and just to make things interesting, our [i]loyal[/i] employees, [b]the Statue Bros[/b], have been let in for their [i]enrichment time[/i]—and by that, we mean they're running around, knocking people over. If they bump you at the wrong time… well, you won't be around for the after party.

[h3]🏃 The Maze[/h3]
You like puzzles? No? Well, too bad! In this Bonus Round, you'll need to navigate a labyrinth that [i]may or may not[/i] come with a handy map. The deeper you go, the tougher it gets. Reach the end? [b]You win prizes![/b] Get lost? Well, that's a personal problem. [i]Oh, and quitting? Yeah, that's a bad look for our ratings, pal.[/i]

[h3]⬜Glass Bridge[/h3]
Simple concept—[b]cross the bridge without falling to your doom.[/b] Sounds easy, right? Well, when each step has a [b]50% chance of shattering beneath your feet[/b], you might want to reconsider who you're trusting to lead the way. Teamwork? Betrayal? [b]Doesn't matter to us, as long as it's entertaining.[/b]

[b]Only One of You Needs to Survive… So, Good Luck![/b]
That's the beauty of Bonus Rounds—you don't [i]all[/i] need to make it through. Just one lucky (or incredibly reckless) contestant needs to reach the end for the rewards to count. So if you [i]happen[/i] to "accidentally" push your buddy off the bridge or use them as bait for the Statue Bros… well, that's just good strategy.

[b]Choose Your Door:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Peace Door[/b]: Win some prizes but death is not the end of your run.
[*] [b]Death Door[/b]: Win [b]MORE[/b] prizes but death will end your run early.
[/list]
[b]IT'S BONUS ROUND TIME![/b] Let luck decide if you thrive… or take a quick trip to the loser's lounge.
Lights, cameras, suffering—[b]Welcome to Episode 0.06.[/b]

[h2]Additional Systems & Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Emote System[/b]: Overhauled interface and animation transitions for smoother, more intuitive emotes
[*] [b]Sitting System[/b]: Sit on chairs and toilets across levels. Stand up by moving, pressing E, or jumping
[*] [b]Crapto Machine[/b]: Trade virtual stocks in the Green Room, complete with real-time updates and easy buy/sell options
[*] [b]Flashbang[/b]: New throwable weapon with explosive effects; use it once and it's gone. Sensitive to bright lights? Find "Photosensitivity Mode" in the settings to darken the scene instead
[/list]

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h2]
We heroically squashed some bugs, optimized a few things, and probably created new problems we haven't found yet. Enjoy the slightly less broken experience![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/1dde6ead6e164eca2f9dacd12e23f2bf0be159fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Episode 0.05: Smarter Scares & Smoother Survival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/116df88b0d5b34f28c8251be3d69966eedd905aa.png[/img]
🎙️ Attention, Contestants! Episode 0.05 is here, and it’s all about giving our Employees a little… edge. They’re smarter, trickier, and definitely scarier—but hey, you’ve got the new Info Panel Screen to even the odds. Oh, and we’ve squashed some bugs to keep things running as smoothly as your doomed attempts to survive.

Get ready to face sharper challenges, smarter frights, and maybe—just maybe—keep yourself alive a little longer.

[h2]🎮 GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]Info Panel Screen:[/h3]
Big news, Contestants! Our sponsors have come through, and now your clueless wandering is slightly less clueless. Unlock info on regularly encountered items in the new Info Panel, conveniently located in the Shop. Oh, and some items? Permanently upgradeable. Progress bars included—because we know you love watching those slowly fill up. You're welcome.

[h3]Arena Upgrades:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Battery Charger Stations:[/b] You complained about flashlights dying. We listened... begrudgingly. Introducing the [i]Battery-B-Gone[/i] Upgrade, complete with charging stations for your Arena. But here’s the kicker: no more consumable batteries. Crank up your stations with Soknee Technologies. Get ready to [i]really[/i] juice up!
[*] [b]Outdoors & Hospital:[/b] Getting lost? We’ve added [i]signposts[/i] Outdoors and [i]posters[/i] in Hospital Arenas. Now you’ll have fewer excuses for wandering in circles like a headless chicken.
[*] [b]Grinder:[/b] Items tossed into the Grinder will now glow once spat out. Because we know you’re all magpies for shiny things.
[/list]
[h3]Item Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Disembodied Arms:[/b] By popular demand, severed limbs are now officially weapons. Yes, you can literally slap monsters with an arm. You're welcome, again.
[*] [b]Boombox:[/b] More range, more jams. Crank up your music, vibe in the van, or take the party into the Arena. Everyone will hear your poor taste in music now!
[*] [b]One-Handed Weapons:[/b] You can now throw one-handed weapons. Perfect for when you just need to chuck something in a panic.
[/list]
[h3]Employee Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Spectre:[/b] Our haunting queen now re-targets and re-emerges in additional rooms after her initial scare. Oh, and if your world starts looking a little desaturated? Congrats, you’re haunted. Shop for a cure. Or don’t. Your call!
[*] [b]Jiangshi:[/b] Less clingy, more strategic. This grabby ghoul will let you go if a friend helps out. But don’t get too comfy—after three escapes, the Jiangshi will get serious. Bring a buddy or become lunch.
[*] [b]Leprechaun:[/b] Sticky fingers? More like slippery fingers! Chase them down for dropped cash as they scamper off. Go get that green!
[*] [b]Statue Bros:[/b]
[list][*][b]Blind Statue:[/b] This one hears you before it sees you. Keep quiet if you spot it first!
[*][b]Deaf Statue:[/b] This one sees your flashlight and will come for you. Light = bad.
[/list][*] [b]Improved Spawning:[/b] Employees now scale with difficulty. Smarter, meaner, and scarier. Good luck.
[/list]
[h3]Greenroom Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Dartboard Fix:[/b] Achievements for darts are now working. Plus, the Dartboard has been moved next to the bathroom.
[/list]
[h2]👁️ USER EXPERIENCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Looping Emotes:[/b] For the dance-obsessed, you can now endlessly emote. Because nothing says ‘teamwork’ like vibing while everyone else panics.
[/list]
[h2]🔊 AUDIO IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Shop Fail Sound FX:[/b]  Broke? You’ll now hear a sad little sound to match your empty wallet.
[/list]
[h2]🔧 BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Head Bobbing:[/b] Stationary now actually means stationary. No more involuntary wheezing cam.
[*] [b]Flashlights:[/b] Upgrades now work as advertised. Stronger beams, proper battery life.
[*] [b]Bloody/Paint Footsteps:[/b] Traces of your dramatic exits now properly show up. Bleed or paint like you mean it!
[*] [b]Vacuum Cleaner:[/b] The overpowered vacuum no longer paralyzes employees. We fixed it. Employees are thrilled. Buckethead and Dog say thanks.
[*] [b]Cosmetic Repairs:[/b] Apoopas Tracksuit and Coiner McGregory no longer split at the seams. Stay stylish, friends.
[*] [b]“This Will Pay For Our Spaceship” Achievement:[/b] Correctly calculates totals now. Flashlights and consumable batteries are officially 20% off.
[*] [b]Quark Networking Sponsor:[/b] Screamers finally shut up when muted. About time.
[*] [b]Basketball Scoreboards:[/b] We got rid of random scoreboard placements. Courts only, happy now?
[*] [b]Sponsor Cameras:[/b] Cameras were spawning in some sponsor boxes, it seems. Yeah, those cameras were [i]our[/i] equipment. Contestants, hands off.
[*] [b]Mimic Door:[/b] Turns out Mimic Doors love MacDongles Burgers. They now chow down properly. Bon appétit.
[/list]
That’s it for this round of updates, folks! We’ve smoothed out your chaos, upgraded your suffering, and made your distractions even shinier. Now get out there and make some real mistakes. See you next time!

notes.notes:

notes.title: Episode 0.04: Arena Unlocked: Campgrounds
notes.notes:

---
[h3]🎮 GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h3]
[list][*] [b]New Arena: Campgrounds[/b]
[list][*] Grab your flashlights, and don’t wander too far from the group—this new arena will keep you on your toes!
[*] [i]Warning: Beware of campfires and overly friendly forest critters.[/i][/list]
[*] [b]New Sponsor Item:[/b] Sponsor Tokens
[list][*] The Sponsors are feeling generous! Collect sponsor tokens hidden inside the arenas and extract them to unlock upgrades in the Shop.
[*] Look under [b]"Upgrades"[/b] in the Shop to purchase these arena upgrades![/list]
[*] [b]New Employee Alert:[/b] Shadow People
[list][*] Think you’re safe checking lockers? Think again.
[*] If they find you, it’s relocation time—whether you wanted it or not! (Where you end up… well, that’s your problem now.)[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234811/c9bb3e0e8b906eefa94c496183c9ce9436e3462f.png[/img]

[list][*] Friendly reminder: Stop staring! The Specter *hates* being the center of attention for too long.[/list]

[list][*] Sticky Situation: Watch your step—getting your foot stuck will slow you down.

[*] Slimy Sneak: Can now slide under doorways. No hiding behind closed doors!
[*] Feed the Blob: It grows bigger if fed… maybe don’t feed it.

[*] [i]Pro tip: Splitting one blob just gives you double the trouble.[/i][/list]

notes.title: Episode 0.03: Limbs, Laughs, and Lockers!
notes.notes:
🎙️ Welcome, welcome, welcome to another [i]7 Minutes in Hell[/i] patch notes update! Get ready for the latest round of fixes, tweaks, and surprises that’ll have you screaming for more!
---
[h3]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The Specter’s been getting a little clingy![/b] Hitching a ride with contestants? Not on our watch! Those [i]whispers[/i] and [i]onscreen effects[/i] no longer overstay their welcome. Now, you’ll only be haunted for the right amount of time!
[*] [b]Sponsor shoutout![/b] Ever tried ordering from [i]Amazoff?[/i] Their deliveries might be slower than this punchline, but your [i]Sponsor Boxes[/i] will now show up [i]right on time[/i] when selected for the round. No more delays, just pure chaos!
[*] [b]What's that smell?[/b] Feeling a little lightheaded? Well, that [i]gas[/i] was messing with more than just your survival skills, but don’t worry, the [i]Truck Timer[/i] at the end of the round is now immune to those fumes. You’ll escape in style—or not!
[*] [b]Hold onto your gear![/b] Our trusty (and slightly mischievous) employees have been told to [i]stop stealing flashlights[/i] from contestants who are downed and holding an item. You’ve got enough to worry about without someone swiping your light!
[*] [b]Folks, we've had some sneaky shenanigans with that Motion Detector![/b] If your team extracted with the sensor still buzzing, those [i]SFX[/i] decided to join the afterparty in the lobby—and stuck around for the rest of the game! That’s right, the [i]Motion Detector[/i] didn’t know when to quit… until the player left the game. But don't worry, we've pulled the plug on that persistent party crasher! Now, your ears can enjoy a well-deserved break between rounds!
[*] and of course, those minor fixes not worth mentioning.
[/list]---
[h3]🎮 Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Knockout Power Unleashed![/b] - Now, contestants can knock each other out! Whether it’s accidental or intentional (no judgments here), be careful where you swing! Friendly fire just got a whole lot funnier.
[*] [b]No body left behind:[/b] - That’s right! You can now carry the bodies of your dead teammates.
[*] [b]Revive Tweaks:[/b] - Get knocked down? Time to get up again!
[list][*] Brief burst of Constitution after Revive - No more instant KO’s after being revived in a trap! —[i]because who wants to die twice that fast?[/i]
[*] Each time you go down, you get back up at 50% of the health you had. Half the health means half the revive time! But heads up—your downed state time will be halved. 
[*] The revive penalty? Gone! Team work makes the dream work, baby!
[/list][*] [b]Arm Penalty Changes[/b] - Alright folks, let’s talk about those Arm Penalty changes—because losing a limb shouldn’t mean losing your whole game! If you lose an arm, it’ll cost you—but here’s the twist! If you manage to take that arm with you to extract, the penalty fees are slashed in half. And the more arms you bring, the more you save! That’s right, contestants—the more limbs you collect, the less it’ll cost you. Who’s ready to haul their way to victory?!
[*] [b]Arena Upgrades:[/b]
[list][*] Lockers - Cashboxes and items can now spawn in lockers, sometimes placed on a convenient eye-level hook. Lockers aren’t just for hiding anymore!
[*] Circuit Boxes - What do these do? Circuit Boxes have been added to the arenas! Smash these and we’ll leave the rest for you to figure out.
[/list][*] [b]Employee Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Queen Spiders - Health and damage have been reduced.
[*] Little Spiders - Now spawning in smaller groups with reduced health and damage.
[/list][*] [b]Greenroom Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Cupboards, Drawers, and Fridges can now be opened!
[*] Greenroom upgrade clipboard moved to shopping/sponsor area.
[*] Unlockable disco ball has been polished.
[/list][/list]---
[h3]🔊 Audio Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Falling Damage SFX:[/b] The sound of gravity just got real. That’s right, we’ve added crisp fall damage SFX to remind you when you’ve bitten off more than your knees can handle!
[*] [b]Charging Statue SFX:[/b] Now, when this creepy figure powers up, you’ll know it—whether that’s comforting or terrifying is up to you.
[/list]---
[h3]👁️ User Experience[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Subtitles On by Default[/b] - That’s right, no more hunting through settings! Subtitles will now be on for everyone, so you’ll never miss a scream, a spooky whisper, or my dazzling commentary!
[*] [b]HUD & UI:[/b] We’ve given your HUD a makeover—fancy, right? 
[list][*] Now you’ve got an updated display for Battery life.
[*] Health is also displayed front and center in the form of a heart.
[*] LMB/RMB interaction keys are displayed above your item containers at the bottom of the screen! No more guessing what button to press in the heat of the moment. We’ve got your back!
[/list][*] [b]Player Names on Uniforms:[/b] Speaking of backs, Player names are now plastered on the backs of your fellow contestants! Unfortunately, you can’t admire your own backpack, but hey, now everyone knows who’s got their back—literally!
[*] [b]Big Red Buttons:[/b] What does this button do? The store chute and exit van buttons are now illuminated and labeled! No more guesswork—just clear, clean visuals to keep you focused on survival and spending your hard-earned cash!
[/list]---
A big, thunderous round of applause to all our brave contestants! We want to say a massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who's been sending in that constructive feedback and submitting those pesky bug reports—whether through Streams, Steam, or our very own 7 Minutes in Hell Discord! You're the real MVPs, helping us make the game more thrilling, terrifying, and downright fun! Keep that feedback coming, because we couldn’t do it without you!

That’s all for this round, folks! Stay tuned for more thrilling updates, and remember, when you’re in 7 Minutes in Hell—the only thing scarier than the monsters is missing out on these juicy patches! 🎙️ JR Out!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Day 2 — Even More Fixes
notes.notes:
Contestants,

We've got even more fixes for Day 2!

Here's a list of all the changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Stuck on loading screens:[/b] This was caused by unlocking a certain achievement. Don’t worry, achievement hunters, we’ve fixed it for you!
[*] [b]Vending machines no longer jam:[/b] Our finest vending machine engineers have been hard at work, and the vending machines are now fully stocked, We just wish people would stop hitting them with pipes.

[*] [i]And of course:[/i] Some minor issues have been resolved, but they don't even deserve an honorable mention.
[/list]
Thanks again for watching, and see you on another episode of 7 Minutes in Hell!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Technical Difficulties Edition - Day 1
notes.notes:
Contestants,

Thanks to everyone for breaking stuff and reporting it. You're helping us make this experience amazing for all of our contestants. ❤️

We have pushed an update, and you can find a list of all the changes below:
[list]
[*] [b]Settings panel issue fixed:[/b] It no longer gets stuck when left open on a loading screen. (We’ve taught it some manners.)
[*] [b]Wider doors in green room:[/b] Doors were slightly widened because we underestimated just how much people would all want to cram through the doorway at the same time.
[*] [b]Flashlight bug fixed:[/b] Flashlights no longer disappear or become unequipable. This was careless on our part—our bad!
[*] [b]Second action on items fixed:[/b] Items now function properly, and no more getting stuck in players’ hands. See reason above.
[*] [b]Sponsor logos fixed:[/b] Logos now display correctly on receipts. Not that you can really read 'em anyway.
[*] [i]Plus, some minor fixes not worth mentioning:[/i] Because they were honestly too small to point out.
[/list]
See you on another episode of 7 Minutes in Hell!

notes.title: 7 Minutes in Hell is the latest co-op horror game on Steam that wants to get you screaming over proximity chat
notes.notes: When a videogame format works, videogame developers make sure we don't forget it: After hits like Phasmophobia and Lethal Company, four-player co-op horror games are the genre du jour—next to extraction shooters, at least—and we now get a new one about about as often as Tim Sweeney says the word "metaverse." The latest is 7 Minutes in Hell, which just released in early access on Steam and challenges up to four players to escape procedurally-generated death mazes with as much cash as they can pick up along the way... Read more.
